name_reason: Compliant fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> game-function name. Domain=battle, descriptor accurately covers both behaviors (decrement/apply per-team status timers + show dialog messages). No Ghidra address residue. Single caller fd2_run_full_turn_cycle uses it exactly as a per-team end-of-turn status ticker, confirming the name.
purpose: End-of-turn status-effect ticker for one team: applies poison damage with a message, then counts down all 6 timer-status slots and shows a removal message when each expires.
logic_summary: Param team selects which side to process (1=player end, 0=enemy intro, 2=new player turn). Pass 1: for each alive char with bTeam==team and poison byte (+0x25)!=0 and (bFlags&1)==0, damage=HP_max/10, clamp HP_current>=0, store damage in dialog value placeholder, pan cursor / load portrait / show dialog text 0x1E7 / clear-kbd / wait(10) / close. After Pass 1: fd2_play_death_animation_and_mark_dead() (poison may have killed someone), then the per-chapter post-action hook for the current chapter runs. Pass 2: for each alive char (bTeam==team, bFlags&1==0) iterate 6 timer slots at +0x22..+0x27 (poison's own slot +0x25 is among them); each non-zero slot decrements, and on reaching 0 shows removal dialog (text 0x1E1+slot) then fd2_recalculate_combat_stats() to drop the expired stat modifier. Function exits via a shared epilogue tail-jump to 0x190a7 (functionally a plain return).

params.name: param_1
params.semantics: Team selector compared against runtime_char.bTeam (+6); only chars on this team are processed. Caller passes 1 (player end-of-turn), 0 (enemy turn intro), 2 (new player turn). Source already names it 'team'.
params.reason: Live Ghidra param is generic placeholder param_1; rename to 'team' to match the source name and its actual role as the team-selection argument. (Apply in Stage 2.)

returns.semantics: No return value; side effects on runtime_char HP/status bytes, dialog value placeholder, anim phase, and on-screen messages.

comment_original_issue: Original src comment was accurate but terse: it folded the death check into Pass 1 (the death-animation call + per-chapter hook actually run between the two passes) and did not note team semantics, the 6 timer-slot byte range, or the benign signed-vs-unsigned division detail.
notes: Source byte-offset accesses (pChar[0x25], pChar[0x22+timer_slot]) are faithful to the disassembly and intentionally read offsets 0x22..0x27; note the Ghidra runtime_char struct types pStatus_flags_block as byte[5] (0x21..0x25), so Pass 2 indices 5,6 (offsets 0x26,0x27) overflow that declared array into bStatus_sleep_flag and the first pCombat_aux_block byte -- a known FD2 array-overflow layout, correctly preserved by using raw byte offsets in src. HP_max/10 uses signed IDIV in the binary but the dividend is a uint16 widened to uint32 (always >=0), so src's unsigned /10 is exact-equivalent (no logic issue). Ghidra plate is comprehensive and consistent with refined understanding; left untouched (only trivial prose 'timer_slot in 0..6' vs loop bound <6, but the index range [1..6] it states is correct).
